{{Quote|Just an unlucky wyvarl who didn't watch where she was going.|Luke Skywalker, regarding a wyvarl caught in a drop-bramble|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
'''Wyvarls''' were a [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] indigenous to a [[Abeloth's planet|planet]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] where the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]] was kept [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] for [[Time/Legends|millennia]], until [[44 ABY]]. Wyvarls were large, bipedal lizards with broad [[Color/Legends|green]] backs, thick tails, and a single blue [[Eye/Legends|eye]]. The lizard had a nictitating membrane that drew down over its [[Eye/Legends|eye]] when it went to sleep. Wyvarls lived in herds, and when in danger, a wyvarl drummed its tail against the ground in order to warn fellow herd-mates to stay away.

In 44 ABY, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] found a [[Gender/Legends|female]] wyvarl that had been trapped in a [[drop-bramble]], a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] barbs. Skywalker used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to make the wvarl go to sleep and then shot it with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] to put her out of her misery.
